exceptions.reason: React 19.3 renders the widget scripts of the React renderer as <script> elements in client rendering, which React does not execute: with React 19.3.0, 6 of the 24 cases of tests/widget-script-runs.test.mts fail in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit with "Encountered a script tag while rendering React component" (C5.8-2-1).
exceptions.removalCondition: Remove the exception when the React renderer runs widget scripts without <script> elements in client rendering and the 24 cases of tests/widget-script-runs.test.mts pass with the latest React release.

exceptions.reason: svelte-check 4.7.6 and @sveltejs/package 3.0.0, which type-check and package the Svelte components, require the TypeScript 6 API: their peer ranges are ^5.0.0 || ^6.0.0 and ^6.0.0, and TypeScript 7 has no such API (the TypeScript exception of config/toolchain.json).
exceptions.removalCondition: Remove the exception when svelte-check and @sveltejs/package admit TypeScript 7 in their peer ranges, together with the exception of config/toolchain.json.
